A Bitcoin Seed Generator Is Using Radioactive Decay for Entropy

An open-source project called Entropy32 Plus uses radioactive decay as a physical entropy source to generate Bitcoin BIP39 seed phrases. A Geiger counter captures decay events, whose timing is processed through SHA-256 before being mapped to the BIP39 wordlist. The device is designed to operate fully offline with no wireless connectivity or persistent seed storage.
